decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API is a core building block of the firm's messaging platform, runs on existing infrastructure at low marginal cost, and supports its integrated multichannel strategy.
The email-to-SMS gateway was launched recently and fits the firm's offer of bridging communication channels for enterprise workflows, with little cost to maintain.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements the email-to-SMS gateway and the inbound API, reuses shared infrastructure, and rounds out the bidirectional messaging offer, so dropping it would save little.
